column1: # ZAP baseline scan rule overrides for the dynamic-check gate (.github/workflows/security.yml).
# 10049 (Storable and Cacheable Content / Non-Storable Content): the API now
# sends Cache-Control: no-store on every response (verdict/api.py,
# no_store_cache_headers), including the 404s ZAP's baseline spider always
# probes for (/, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml — none of which are real routes on
# this control-plane API). The finding is a byproduct of doing the secure
# thing, not a gap, so it is ignored rather than left to fail the gate.

column3: (non-storable content on expected 404s; no-store is already applied)
